sloka: विचित्र माल्य आभरणा कदाचित् क्षौम धारिणी ।अचरत् पर्वतस्य अग्रे प्रावृड् अंबुद सन्निभे ॥४-६६-११॥
transliteration: vicitra mālya ābharaṇā kadācit kṣauma dhāriṇī ।acarat parvatasya agre prāvṛḍ aṁbuda sannibhe ॥4-66-11॥

translations.english: 'She was the daughter of a great king of monkeys called Kunjara. That young and beautiful lady had assumed a lustrous human form decked with wonderful garlands, ornaments and silk clothes and was roving on top of the mountain which appeared like a proud raincloud.
translations.hindi: इस लबे चोड़े आकाश को स्पर्श करने वाले मेरु पर्वत तक हजार धार आ जा सकता हूँ
